text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-8342 - GPU_POOL_3 memory_pressure HIGH (kvcache-prefetch surge). 112 alloc failures in 2m. Auto-mitigation attempted: soft-shed, but errors persisting.

pagerduty: Incident PD-8342 created and routed to @eng-oncall primary schedule. Escalation policy: 3m -> secondary.

jordan: acked. I'm on it, jumping into logs. Can someone check if Dedicated autoscaler triggered?

priya: saw the alert. autoscaler shows no pods added in the last 5m, pods in that pool are at 98% GPU mem. Might be fragmentation, not raw capacity.

sam: i can repro some cublas alloc failures from recent deploys in the env there. pushing a small diagnostic now.

maya: customer impact? any 5xx reports?

jordan: dashboards show spike in generation errors and increased tail latency for several routes (~500ms -> 2.8s P95). A handful of requests returned 5xx allocate_failed. Marking as partial degradation.

priya: i'm running nvml summary on nodes in GPU_POOL_3:
```
for node in $(kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-pool-3 -o name); do ssh $node 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.free,utilization.gpu --format=csv'; done
```
Results: multiple GPUs show >98% used but with small pockets of free memory — indicates fragmentation / KV cache growth.

sam: logs: repeated errors like:
```
E tensorflow: cublasCreate failed: resource allocation error
E runtime: cudaMalloc returned out of memory (after retries)
```
Also seeing repeated KV cache growth messages from model backend.

jordan: ok — mitigation plan: 1) temporarily disable aggressive kv-prefetch on pool 3 2) scale down long-lived debug workloads 3) drain a couple of least-used nodes to force model workers to relocate 4) if that fails, route some traffic to GPU_POOL_2 (less loaded).

priya: disabling prefetch via feature flag now:
```
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/llm-worker PREFETCH_KV=false --record
```
Applying to pool-3 only.

ops-bot: :gear: rollout triggered: deployment/llm-worker updated in namespace infra (PREFETCH_KV=false) for selector pool=gpu-pool-3.

sam: i'm evicting a low-traffic node to free real contiguous memory. command: `kubectl drain gpu-node-27 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

maya: ping SRE if nodes don't start accepting new pods. also flag customers with degraded SLAs (prod-tier) — support notified.

jordan: support updated: ticket INC-12998 created to notify impacted customers; note: small % of requests returned 500s, retries succeed for most.

priya: after prefetch disable, error rate dropped ~60% in first 2 minutes. GPU mem usage still high but less fragmentation. KV cache evictions started to happen.

sam: draining node was successful; pods rescheduled to pool-2 and pool-1, a few hit OOM on restart but most booted on smaller models fallback.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Auto-shedder completed a soft-shed sweep on GPU_POOL_3. 18 pods soft-terminated.

jordan: good progress. I'll keep this as mitigated for now. We should run a follow-up: increase node defragment interval and add a forced compaction step. Create a ticket for a longer-term fix.

maya: looping in runtime team for investigation on KV growth pattern — @sam can you capture a heap/profile and attach to RT ticket RT-4821?

sam: on it, grabbing kvcache snapshot and tracer. will attach in 20m.

priya: monitoring: latency P95 back down to ~900ms, error rate trending toward baseline. No new pager in last 12m.

pagerduty: PD-8342 acknowledged by jordan. Escalation paused.

jordan: handing off to on-shift SRE for follow-up. @maya take primary for post-incident and customer comms. I'll update runbook notes and handover.

maya: taking it. I'll post a short RCA draft later today and coordinate a postmortem if needed. For now: mitigated, partial degradation, customer impact limited to transient 5xx and elevated latency for some routes.

sam: attaching logs and nvml snapshots to RT-4821 and INC-12998.

jordan: thanks team. closing thread once ops confirms steady state for 30m. :thumbsup:
